failed_or_abandoned: Factorising the WimPyDD kernel as F^2(E) theta(v - v_min(E)) to avoid recomputing kernels per delta: invalid for natural xenon (each isotope has its own threshold; seven partial-sum levels observed), so full (E, v) kernels were computed for 21 configurations (39 min).

kappa-profiled joint likelihood as the headline f2 limit: returns no limit because the exothermic population can replace the endothermic event at kappa ~ 1e-7; reported as the kappa-f2 degeneracy and as the 'event is exothermic' hypothesis test instead.
Reading xenon isotope masses via WD.Xe.element[0].mass returned a scalar; WD.Xe.mass holds the nine isotope masses.
First full run exceeded the 10-minute foreground limit and continued in the background; four parallel kernel workers were added so later runs read the cache (5 s).
